content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am facing trouble downloading a program to a [product_name]. For communication between the [product_name] device and the [product_name] software ([version_no]), I use a [product_name] cable. The error I receive is "Invalid XOR Sum (Transmit Error)." My HP laptop lacks a COM port, so I use a USB to COM converter and connect the [product_name] cable to the [product_name]. Interestingly, I can upload a program from the controller without issue. Can anyone suggest what may cause this error? Thank you.
Hello, I believe the issue is related to the USB-to-RS232 converter. Try using the official USB programming cable [article_no] for better compatibility. Hope this helps.

Hi, I haven't experienced this problem before, but if uploading works fine, consider making a backup first. Check whether your controller matches your application's requirements and verify that you are not referencing modules that aren't physically present. It's a good practice to 'Clear PLC' to ensure a fresh system before attempting to download your project again. Best of luck!

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing communication errors when downloading to a [product_name] from [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] using a USB to COM adapter. The error 'Invalid XOR Sum (Transmit Error)' occurs, while uploading works fine. Feedback indicates that the USB-to-RS232 converter may not be fully compatible and recommends trying a different cable or verifying hardware connections. This highlights the difficulties of connecting industrial devices to modern laptops lacking traditional COM ports and the need for thorough hardware compatibility checks.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks a reliable solution to download programs from a laptop without a COM port to a [product_name] via USB-to-COM, expecting to avoid transmission errors and achieve seamless communication.
